---
name: php
description: Make focused PHP changes using the project's framework, PHP version, and plugin APIs.
---

# PHP skill

1. Inspect the relevant PHP files and dependency manifests to identify the PHP version, framework, and plugin APIs.
2. Follow existing structure, naming, formatting, and error-handling conventions.
3. Keep changes focused; do not edit third-party or vendor plugin code.
4. Reuse existing dependencies and APIs. Do not add packages or plugins without a clear need and user approval.
5. Validate and escape input and output at the appropriate boundaries.
6. Run the smallest relevant test, lint, or syntax check available.
